glosses: with (a document, a vote, a method)
patterns.usage_note: Names the medium or instrument an act travels through, attaching to an abstract noun: a document, a method, a faculty (書面をもって知らせる, 投票をもって決める). The sibling entries mark the point at which something takes effect or ends (本日をもって閉店) and the criterion a judgment rests on (所定の基準をもって). It is not usually used of everyday physical tools, where で is normal (箸で食べる); 身をもって, 'firsthand', is a fixed idiom.

examples.ruby: 選考[せんこう]の結果[けっか]は書面[しょめん]をもってお知[し]らせします。
examples.english: You will be notified of the selection results in writing.

examples.ruby: 最新[さいしん]の技術[ぎじゅつ]をもって難[むずか]しい修復[しゅうふく]に挑[いど]んでいる。
examples.english: They are taking on a difficult restoration with the latest technology.

examples.ruby: 委員[いいん]の選出[せんしゅつ]は投票[とうひょう]をもって行[おこな]う。
examples.english: Committee members shall be selected by ballot.

patterns.usage_note: Names the means, cause, or passive agent behind an event: the method something is achieved by (話し合いによって解決する), the cause it resulted from (地震によって), or the doer in a passive (シェークスピアによって書かれた). Two sibling entries take the other readings of this form: conformity to a rule (規則によって禁じられている) and case-to-case variation (人によって違う). It is not used of everyday hand tools, where で is normal.

examples.ruby: 事故[じこ]によって電車[でんしゃ]が三十分[さんじっぷん]も遅[おく]れた。
examples.english: The accident held the train up by a full thirty minutes.

examples.ruby: 話[はな]し合[あ]いによって問題[もんだい]を解決[かいけつ]したい。
examples.english: I'd like to settle the matter through discussion.

examples.ruby: この寺[てら]は江戸時代[えどじだい]の名工[めいこう]によって建[た]てられた。
examples.english: This temple was built by a master craftsman of the Edo period.
